subject: VMWARE_ESXI_REFERENCE_GOVERNANCE
statement: The repository mechanically traces every VMware experiment from Tech Story to representative VMware run and hash-bound VMware evidence, derives non-closing acceptance associations from requiredTechStories, keeps QEMU controls under a distinct typed subject, and binds the schema-valid V17 O4 and V19 O0 canonical results plus the exact-build g101 cross-owner frozen observed register-state profile.
limitations: Historical pyVmomi task identifiers and initiating actors are not uniformly retained.

Historical VMware runs do not all conform to contracts/vmware-experiment-result.schema.json; VMW-AER-COR-001 now has schema-valid V17 O4 and V19 O0 canonical results, while their full raw bundles remain separately retained local artifacts.
Representative run IDs do not imply that every legacy case has a canonical result.

The QEMU AER root-sequence run remains a separately typed reference positive control and is not VMware evidence. V17 and V19 establish only the exact ESXi O4/O0 g101 external register-state slices and their field-exact snapshot equivalence for the frozen build, device, and QEMU binary. They do not establish a bound native-driver O0 path, other gates, notification or service attribution, guest writes, lifecycle recovery, physical health, or VMware private implementation.
Derived acceptance links remain non-closing associations; this index is traceability evidence, not case completion evidence.
This reference-governance result cannot close a Qman product case, risk, implementation milestone, qualification profile, or release gate.
